GePriceForResizeInstance.clientToken: Idempotency token, an ASCII string no longer than 64 characters
GePriceForResizeInstance.nodeType:
Node specification. Valid for Redis memory-optimized and Redis capacity-optimized types.
Get specific specifications via the [Get Instance Specification List](https://cloud.baidu.com/doc/SCS/s/ikhvw6dqg) API.
GePriceForResizeInstance.replicationNum:
Number of replicas, defaults to 1.
Valid for Redis memory-optimized and Redis capacity-optimized types.
GePriceForResizeInstance.diskFlavor:
Capacity per shard, in GB.
Valid for Redis capacity-optimized type.
GePriceForResizeInstance.chargeType: Billing type. Prepaid (prepay) / Postpaid (postpay). The billing type must match the original instance.
GePriceForResizeInstance.period: Billing cycle. Required when billing type is prepaid, in months.
GePriceForResizeInstance.changeType:
Change type.
modifyType: Price inquiry identifier when changing Redis Standard Edition to Cluster Edition; required in this case.
